correctness.rationale: For every epsilon in (0,1/2), the displayed 2 by 2 inverse matrix has both induced 1-norm and rho(|inverse of A|) equal to 1/2+epsilon<1; exact formulas make (+,-) the unique false DPO maximizer while (+,+) is the AVE solution.

originality.rationale: The historical review found no located source with this two-dimensional DPO sharpness family and distinguished earlier one-half thresholds for other properties.

value.rationale: The historical review judged the dimension-minimal robust threshold counterexample scientifically valuable.
